correctness.rationale: Normalized triangular barycentric coordinates are Dirichlet(1,1,1), yielding E f^n=2 h_n/((n+1)(n+2)). For zero-sum vertex values a,b,c, generating series is [1−(s2/2)t²−(s3/3)t³]^{-1}; coefficient extraction gives the stated normalized 2m-moment polynomial with L_m=2×6^m/[(2m+1)(2m+2)] and η=6s3²/s2³∈[0,1]. Discriminant s2³(1−η)/2 shows endpoint vertex patterns; polynomial has positive η coefficients for m≥3, strict edge min and altitude max, with m=2 invariant 12/5. Absolute third moment is a Hermite–Genocchi divided difference; differentiating its one-variable r∈(0,1) profile proves strict reverse extremizers and bounds 46sqrt2/45 and 3sqrt6/5. Independent exact Dirichlet calculations for m=2,3,4 checked edge and altitude ratios, and symbolic recurrence checked normalizations; this finite check is not the all-m proof.
